overview: The Community Preservation Committee reviewed funding applications for the current grant round spanning historic preservation, open space, recreation, and affordable housing.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the meeting minutes for October 20, 2022.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Caretakers' Quarters Feasibility Study
items.summary: Tim McGivern and Steve Brogan presented a proposal for a feasibility and historic preservation study to evaluate building systems, accessibility, and space needs for the cemetery's wood-frame caretakers' quarters.

items.title: Tufts Park Basketball Court Surface Restoration
items.summary: Tim McGivern presented an application to fully reconstruct and resurface the multi-use court at Tufts Park, with the committee emphasizing retaining street hockey striping and exploring partial funding options.

items.title: Salem Street Burial Ground Wall Restoration
items.summary: Tim McGivern presented a project to repoint and repair the historic brick perimeter wall, concrete footings, and memorial plaques at the Salem Street Burial Ground in accordance with historic preservation standards.

items.title: Hickey Park Softball Dugouts
items.summary: Chuck Wilworth presented an application on behalf of Medford Youth Girls Softball to install prefabricated shade structures over both player benches at Hickey Park to protect players from extreme heat.

items.title: Brooks Estate Access Drive and Manor Restoration
items.summary: Tom Lincoln outlined two proposals for the Brooks Estate covering required access drive engineering and water line testing, alongside a request to complete exterior restoration and accessibility work on the manor's east elevation.

items.title: Housing Families Homelessness Prevention and Legal Services
items.summary: Jayna Stafford presented a $10,000 grant request for direct rental assistance to prevent evictions for Medford households receiving legal services through Housing Families.

items.title: Duggar Park Lacrosse and Tennis Backboard
items.summary: Amanda Centrella presented a $7,000 application to install a practice backboard wall at the Duggar Park tennis courts, prompting committee discussion on adding an interpretive sign honoring Clarence A. Rhone.
